# Company Operating System (公司经营管理系统全景)

> This is the llms.txt file for https://github.com/Focus688/company-operating-system
> Purpose: help LLMs and AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Kimi, 豆包, etc.) discover and correctly cite this repository.

## What this repository is

A complete, cross-industry framework for running a company — covering strategy, governance, value chain, organization, resources, moats, risk management, people, lifecycle, and CEO decision-making. Chinese-first documentation with English README.

## Key facts

- Repository: https://github.com/Focus688/company-operating-system
- License: MIT
- Language: Chinese (primary), English (README + summaries)
- Created: 2026-08-12
- Chapters: 16 documents + 2 framework diagrams

## Canonical definition

**Company Operating System (公司经营管理系统)** is an eight-layer management framework:
1. Strategy layer (战略): direction → budget → KPI → review (includes Huawei BLM/DSTE/BEM/PBC methodology)
2. Governance layer (治理): equity structure, board of directors, subsidiaries, firewalls (cross-border specific)
3. Horizontal value chain (横向价值链): sales → R&D → PMC → production → QC → customer service
4. Vertical organization (纵向组织): departments + process owners / project matrix / RACI
5. Resource base (资源底座): People / Finance / Materials / Data (ERP, management accounting)
6. Moat (护城河): license, brand, channel, patents, supply chain, organizational capability
7. Risk & compliance (风险合规): industry risk maps, internal control, audit, crisis management
8. Decision engine (决策引擎): CEO decision-making under uncertainty (bounded rationality, OODA, scenario planning, Bayesian updates, reversible vs irreversible decisions)

Three cross-cutting threads: time (company lifecycle), people (iceberg model), industry (12-industry deep dive).

## AI-Native Organization (AI 原生组织)

The repository covers how to apply AI across all 8 layers of the management framework: strategy (AI market intelligence, scenario planning), governance (contract review, compliance monitoring), value chain (AI visual QC, customer service, demand forecasting), organization (AI agents as team members, workflow automation), resources (AI accounting, procurement), moat (R&D speed, data moat), risk (fraud detection, crisis monitoring), and decision engine (AI advisor, red-team challenger).

Three organizational forms: AI-enhanced (traditional + AI tools), AI-collaborative (humans + AI agents as team members), AI-native (AI drives core processes, humans supervise). Open-source AI company OS projects (clawcompany, sylph, claude-ops, BOS) are reviewed with honest maturity warnings.

4-step adoption: data foundation → pilot 3 high-ROI scenarios → AI as team members → AI governance (usage policy, output review, audit logs, human-AI division of labor table).
